name: Almost Heaven Timberline 6-Person Outdoor Cabin Sauna
description: Please note: Due to the size of the Timberline, it will ship via a flatbed truck and will not fit on a liftgate. This means that you will be responsible for offloading the sauna. We recommend gathering 3-4 people to offload the sauna piece by piece or renting a forklift. Alternatively, you can add a Driver Offload service at checkout if you would like a hands-off offloading experience. Almost Heaven Timberline 6-Person Outdoor Cabin Sauna The Timberline will enhance any backyard or outdoor setting, providing a contemporary look to the authentic sauna experience. The wrap-around front porch includes privacy panels, and the sauna room has wide multi-level benches, which are accented by a railing that also serves as a footrest for the upper bench. The high-sloped ceilings provide an open feel, and there is plenty of room for you and five others to enjoy the heat. The cabin design is built to withstand all weather conditions. Thick spruce lumber panels provide excellent insulation, and you can even stain the exterior to match your aesthetic. Choose either an electric heater or wood-burning stove for a true traditional sauna experience. Step into your backyard and enjoy all the Timberline cabin sauna has to offer. Features Thick Nordic spruce timber wall sections Double tongue-and-groove profiling of timber sections Tempered glass window and door Multi-level seating Clear spruce upper and lower benches Safety rail and upper bench foot support Wrap-around exterior porch Exterior privacy panels Electric or wood-burning heater options Sloped roof with porch covering Note: roofing shingles not included A door equipped with a lock Insulated ceiling Adjustable upper and lower vents Specifications Holds between four and six people Standard heater (Harvia KIP80B): 8 kW, 240V , 40-amp electrical requirement, hardwire connect Exterior dimensions with porch: 128”W x 112”D x 107”H Sauna room exterior dimensions: 80”W x 75”D Interior dimensions: 75”W x 70”D x 88”H Upper bench dimensions: 75”L x 36”W Lower bench dimensions: 75”L x 18”W Door size: 75”H x 32”W Window size: 68”W x 20”H Shipping dimensions: Package 1: 103” x 8” x 8” (support post) Package 2: 84”x 48” x 50” (sauna) Shipping weight: Package 1: 25 lbs Package 2: 1800 lbs Assembled weight: approx. 1,750 lbs Options & Customizations Heater: You can upgrade the Timberline from the standard Harvia KIP80B heater to the heater of your choice! Lighting: Choose between the standard warm white LED Lighting or Mood Lighting for colors. Care & Maintenance Traditional saunas require very little upkeep. Simply wipe down the interior after each use and check for any dust or debris that you may have tracked in. Shipping & Assembly The Timberline will ship via a flatbed truck. Definite handyman or contracting skills are required. The instructions are basic and written for a global market with the assumption that the assembler has construction experience. Do not attempt to build on your own if you are not familiar with construction practices nor able to work with general instructions. It is recommended that you read the assembly manual in advance if you are unsure of your ability. Two people can generally assemble the unit in 2-3 days. Two Ways to Enjoy Your Sauna Heater and stones are essential to a traditional sauna experience. With the room at least heated to 160ºF, the traditional sauna can be enjoyed in two ways. The first is called a dry sauna, which lacks any added moisture. The second is called a wet sauna, where you sprinkle water onto the heated stones to create a refreshing burst of steam and added humidity.
